batchSize.description: The number of items to process in a single batch.

timeout.description:
The maximum time allowed before {@link DocExport#generateDocumentation} throws
an error, expressed as a serialized duration string. This ensures the function
doesn't hang indefinitely.

title:
Configuration options for batch processing in documentation export jobs.
Defines the size and timeout for processing batches of items.
name: DocExport.DocGenSpec.BatchJobOptions
